intro.bio: Recent graduate of NUS Law (L.L.B. Second (Upper) Class Honours). I'm currently studying for the Bar while working for Frontier Commons, learning to use technology and AI to build digital tools to solve real problems.

items.name: Cadgy clone
items.summary: A working rebuild of OneLook's Cadgy, a daily word-tile puzzle. It includes new features such as hosting accounts, a guest login, and a user submission page where you can create your own puzzles for anyone in the community to play, either on your own or by connecting with a Gemini API Key to suggest the board - Try it out!

items.name: KNOWN
items.stack: Gloo AI Hackathon · Frontier Commons team
items.summary: A private app made for someone carrying difficult emotions, like an international student facing loneliness or grief. They name what they're carrying through pictures or their own words, meet someone in Scripture who carried something similar, and chooses a gentle response: pray, sit with it, reflect, or reach out. Built with the Frontier Commons team for Track 2, Scripture Beyond the App, in five different languages, with no account and nothing saved unless she chooses to share.

items.name: Personal finance tracker
items.stack: Google Apps Script · Gemini · Claude Code
items.summary: Tracking money by hand was cumbersome, and the apps I tried cost money without doing what I wanted. Bank alert emails from UOB, PayLah, ShopBack, Grab and others are parsed and categorised automatically into a review tab. Once ticked, they flow into income or expenses and a monthly summary. Cash receipts can also be sent in as photos.

items.name: Tailored fitness app
items.summary: For beginners, or people getting back into fitness, who find tutorials and existing apps too impersonal. A chatbot asks questions that build on each other: your health, history, goals, experience and habits. It then produces a personal site with a phase-gated plan, a workout calendar and a log that you can edit.

items.name: Of Good Heart
items.summary: A creative ecommerce brand named after the Chinese saying 世上无难事，只怕有心人: nothing is difficult if you put your heart into it. It makes encouraging digital and physical products, with Instagram stories as its main funnel. I built its production schedule and a P&L model, and it's where I'm learning to grow as an entrepreneur.
items.note: Side note: I'm also working on scaling a content production system as a service-product led business into a venture with my partner. Hoping to get these projects kicked off in 2027 and 2028!

items.name: FC-Bootcamp
items.summary: The repo for my run through the Frontier Commons Build Bootcamp. This holds the foundational architecture that I use for all my projects; The design.md, architecture, schema and the PRD and planning docs that scope them.

entries.note: Learning to use technology and AI to solve real problems. In a cross-border team, I'm learning to research, prototype, user-test and ship digital tools.

Experiencing the commercial side of business. Building P&L and market-sizing models for new initiatives showed me how an idea becomes a viable venture, and grew my commercial and entrepreneurial skills. Also learning to work with different stakeholders in both private and public service.
Growing in rigour and legal writing. Experience in drafting legal research, memos for counsel, as well as meeting with clients.
Learning to intertwine my legal skills with my conviction for justice. Working on child abuse and trafficking cases in Manila showed me what the law can do for the most vulnerable.
